entries.speaker: Using the Laundromat
entries.en: Using the Laundromat will cause time to pass,[n]but you will be able to wash [clr 2]sooty armor[clr 27] for[n]400 yen. Doing so will clean it and reveal its[n]true potential.

entries.speaker: Using the Laundromat
entries.en: Up to [clr 2]four[clr 27] items can be washed in a cycle. The[n]item you receive is [clr 2]up to chance[clr 27]. Be sure to visit[n]the laundromat when you have [clr 2]sooty armor[clr 27].
